confidence_notes: Restaurant and cafe anchors rest on Numbeo user-submitted snapshots and Essaouira price guides of mixed dates (2024-2026), so treat them as ballpark; the indexed Numbeo Essaouira copy appears dated. Beer, cocktail and wine are less certain because licensed venues are limited, draught beer is uncommon and venue prices vary widely. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season and were not checked against live listings or accommodation searches. Dirham prices were converted at an approximate, unverified rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single Essaouira aggregate covered every item, so restaurant and cafe anchors combine Essaouira-specific Numbeo and guide ranges, with Agadir (a similar Atlantic resort city) as the closest comparable and Casablanca and Marrakech as wider cross-checks. Cocktail is cross-checked against local beer (about twice the beer price) because venue data were thin; wine glass follows Essaouira restaurant glass ranges. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for a coastal medina resort town, not sourced from listings.
